prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Conroe, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1303; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were involved in on a street in Conroe, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please describe in your own words what happened.

A: I was turning left at an intersection with a green light. I had my turn signal on and I was going slowly, maybe fifteen miles per hour. A pickup coming from the other direction hit the front driver's side of my car.

Q: Did you see the pickup before the impact?

A: Not really. I was watching for oncoming cars to clear, and I think it came through the intersection quickly. I didn't have time to react.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did the airbags deploy?

A: I don't think so. The impact knocked me sideways against the door, though.

Q: Tell me about your injuries.

A: My right knee hit the dashboard and the pain has been bad since. I went to urgent care that afternoon and they took X-rays. The doctor said it was a sprain and possibly a torn ligament, and they referred me to an orthopedic specialist. I'm still walking with a brace and I can't drive much right now.

Q: Are you currently receiving any treatment?

A: Yes, physical therapy twice a week, and I'm waiting on an MRI.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?

A: Only that I'm sure I had the right of way with the green light and the turn signal on. I've been cooperative with the other driver's insurance company as well.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
